summary: The web app and SDK apply 11 Effect language-service fixes with no behavior change, and the objectives reader runs through an Effect atom with the same cancellation as before (a pending read aborts on unmount or refresh)

replay.detail: Web and SDK client modules only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: No wire, API or client protocol changes. packages/fractal-sdk's submitAction names its result type ActionResult instead of typeof ActionResult.Type, the same type.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous code paths; no state is written differently.
